findings.rule: crates/AGENTS.md: carry canonical leaves through all producers; unchanged producers belong to the migration.
findings.evidence: Trim::default still assigned native [1.0, 0.77, 0.34] and 0.25 to Metal.color:Srgb and Metal.roughness:Ratio. This production default cannot type-check against the changed record.
findings.correction: Admit Srgb::from_encoded_channels([1.0, 0.77, 0.34]) and Ratio::from_ratio(0.25) at this exact authored literal, retaining scratch_density 0 and all other fields/defaults.
findings.status: Initial-pin actionable finding. Root changed this source during review; current successor has not received full independent clearance.

findings.path: crates/fabelgeist-armor/src/material.rs; construction.rs; lib.rs; Creator clothing.rs; Armor trim/finish.rs
findings.rule: crates/AGENTS.md: cohesive fallible APIs sharing one error use an owning Result alias; trait error parameters remain explicit.
findings.evidence: At initial pin Metal::validate/ValidatedMetal::new repeat MetalError; Construction/Tiling/Plate/Lacing validate repeat ConstructionError; six Armor root encode/decode/hash/validate functions repeat DesignError; Clothing constructors and generator repeat ClothingError. Newly touched trim validate has TrimMaterialError. New LinearSurfaceMaterial TryFrom instead uses SurfaceProjectionResult<Self>, whose only user is that trait method.
findings.correction: Use MetalResult, ConstructionResult, DesignResult, ClothingResult and TrimMaterialResult in their cohesive ordinary APIs, retaining exactly the existing error types. Use standard Result<Self, Self::Error> for the projection trait, removing its otherwise unused alias; do not add a forwarding helper merely to use an alias.
findings.status: Initial-pin R3 finding; Root successor modifications underway, not verified by this initial receipt.

findings.path: modified owner declaration blocks, detailed in MD
findings.rule: crates/AGENTS.md: imports/reexports, modules, constants/aliases, structs, enums, traits, impls, then public/private functions; tests last.
findings.evidence: Concrete initial-pin examples: Armor lib reexports interspersed with modules including new surface_material reexport at94; construction enum/impl before Tiling/Plate/Lacing/error; garment_material MailMaps reexport after mod and MailSurface after impls; Tactical meshes tests at88 before private native functions. More receiving locations are enumerated in MD.
findings.correction: Move whole declaration blocks with docs/attributes; keep executable bodies, cfg, visibility, error order and fixture bodies byte-exact. No pass-through module.
findings.status: Initial-pin R4 finding; multiple successor blocks changed during review and require fresh receipt.
